entries.138e179aa69c3311: It is a car subscription service for individuals that does not require physical stores, with procedures completed entirely online. Lease vehicles are owned by partner financial companies, so the company group in principle holds no vehicle inventory.

entries.e2b6e322fc80fc35: As its management policy, the company has set a mission of 'Happiness, for Future Generations' and a vision of 'The Arrow That Transforms Japan', and operates as an industrial DX company. In the Automotive Industry DX Business, the company says it will lead the formation of an 'automotive distribution DX economic sphere' by building a platform that integrates online, offline and DX, and will pursue a roll-up strategy of rolling out the car dealership DX model proven at its consolidated subsidiary Patio Co., Ltd. horizontally to used-car dealers and new-car dealerships nationwide. In the Horizontal DX Business, the company says it will diversify its solutions and thoroughly provide hands-on support on-site through its professional network.
